files..github/workflows/main.yml:
name: CI
on:
  - push
  - pull_request
jobs:
  test:
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version:
          - 20
          - 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test

files.REPORUSH.md:
# RepoRush training fork

Upstream: https://github.com/sindresorhus/p-map
Revision: 2ba3a002acac080c60c47ca1dfa2fad3e17f5b7c (v7.0.3)
Fork: https://github.com/AayushmanVibhu/p-map

An intentionally introduced regression changes the ordering of concurrently mapped results. Slow early inputs move behind later inputs. Trace index assignment, result storage, and skipped-result filtering in the full implementation.

## Expected behavior
Results follow input order even when mapper promises complete in a different order; skipped results remain omitted.

## Run the regression
Use Node.js 20 or newer. Run npm install --ignore-scripts.
Run node --test reporush/regression.test.mjs. Run npm test for the upstream suite.

Upstream source, documentation and licenses are retained. One intentional source mutation and this regression test were added for training.
Binary/oversized files omitted: none.

The browser Run/Submit buttons perform static patch checks; run the Node regression for behavioral verification.
